messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we're targeting a public announce for Redwood Optimize v0.9 on Wed 09:00 PT. Marketing needs final changelog link, docs link, and a small benchmark blurb by EOD Tue. Can eng/docs confirm?
Sanjay: On it. Changelog PR is merged to main but I need docs to publish the user-facing section before we point people. I can give the PR permalink now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412 (will update once published).
Liam: Docs team will publish the 'Optimize' guide and anchor today. ETA Tue 14:00 PT — I'll post the canonical URL here.
Olivia: Rollout note from eng: we'll do a staggered rollout — canary at 09:00 PT, then 30m observe, then 100% at ~09:30 PT if no regressions. If marketing needs full availability at 09:00 for the press window we can make the canary public but keep capacity low.
Maya: Good — please confirm if the canary will serve all regions or just us-west for the first 30m. Also need p95 latency numbers and token-cost delta for the blog.
Samir: Canary will be us-west only initially. I'll take p95 snapshots from the infra dashboard right after the canary goes live and post them here. I can also export the 7-day baseline vs optimize-run CSV for the blog.
Priya: Webinar update: we've set a webinar for Thu 10:00 PT. Landing page exists but needs the final product blurb and a CTA that routes people to the SDR queue 'inbound-launch-Optimize'. Can eng add a tracking param to the docs link so we can attribute leads? e.g., ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9
Sanjay: Yes. We'll add the param when we publish the docs link. Also adding a lead tag 'optimize-launch' in the event payload makes sense.
Priya: For routing, FYI the SDR queue expects a JSON webhook with these fields. Example rule for ops:
```
{
  "source": "web-forms",
  "campaign": "optimize_v0.9",
  "tag": "optimize-launch",
  "route_to": "sdr-inbound/optimize"
}
```
Can someone from eng confirm the webhook event will include the tag?
Sanjay: We'll include "tag": "optimize-launch" in the payload. I'll ping @release-bot to ensure the deploy includes the updated event schema.
release-bot: Scheduled deploy: optimize/service v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00, full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: green.
Maya: Perfect. Marketing deliverables: blog post draft (include p95, cost delta, 1 chart) and 4 social tiles + one example tweet. Can we get the p95 snapshot and CSV by Tue 15:00 so designer can mock the chart?
Samir: Will post the p95 screenshot and attach CSV here by Tue 15:00.
Liam: Docs URL will be live by Tue 14:00: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v0.9 — we'll append ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 as requested.
Maya: Thanks — once you post that link I'll add it to the launch checklist and to the webinar landing page. Anyone have blockers?
Olivia: No blockers from eng. We'll watch canary metrics closely and revert plan ready.
Priya: SDR playbook: please tag any incoming leads with "optimize-launch" and set priority level to P2. I'll confirm the routing once we see the first webhook.
Maya: Great — final ask: after docs live, post the changelog link + docs link here with the exact URLs and the one-line summary (2 sentences max) for the tweet. I'll assemble the announcement assets and schedule the post for Wed 09:05 PT. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: Will do — expect final message in this thread Tue 14:10 PT with links and summary.
